mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate level (above 4.0%) compresses equity valuations by increasing the cost of capital, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% with a monthly rise exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 5.0 and UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 5.0 and rise > 0.2pp), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in monthly payrolls (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals severe labor market contraction, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, high consumer spending (RSAFS) signals overconsumption and potential inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of late-cycle expansion periods with RSAFS above 12-month moving average, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates weakening manufacturing and services output, reducing corporate earnings and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1000 thousand units signals housing market collapse, reducing consumer wealth and spending, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST < 1000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% compresses real equity valuations by eroding purchasing power and increasing uncertainty, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE) level above 5.0% signals weak labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
